🇺🇸🇷🇺🇪🇺🇺🇦 US pushes plan to bring RUSSIAN GAS back to Europe through UKRAINE

Washington is reportedly pushing to restart Russian gas exports through Ukrainian pipelines, with a U.S. intermediary handling the sales.

Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner reportedly raised the proposal during September talks in Moscow and Kyiv.

Russian gas transit through Ukraine stopped in January 2025; the EU plans to phase out Russian pipeline gas by late 2027.

Germany and Poland oppose renewed purchases, while Slovakia remains open to Russian supplies.

The proposal comes as European gas prices surge and storage levels remain below normal.

The White House wants Russian gas flowing again, but much of Europe isn't ready to reopen the tap.

Source: WSJ, Bloomberg / Writer: Marie
